name: solder
description: A lean coding agent in a side panel, for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with tool calling. Organizations can enforce its settings with Group Policy or Intune.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Solder edits files in the workspace.

solder.endpoint.markdownDescription: The full Chat Completions address, ending in `/chat/completions`. The key is set with **Solder: Set API key**.

solder.model.description: The model new chats use (each chat can pick its own beside Send).

solder.assistModels.markdownDescription: The Assist models, by id: plain-text models reached through Solder's text protocol (and the gateway's sessions). Every other model is a Tool model. Easiest to set in Solder's Settings (Advanced → Kinds of model). When this is empty, **Tool models** decides instead.

solder.toolModels.markdownDescription: A regular expression: models whose id matches are **Tool models** (a system prompt and native tool calls); every other model is an **Assist model**, which takes plain text only and is reached through Solder's text protocol and the gateway's sessions. Empty: every model is a Tool model.

solder.assistSessionBlock.markdownDescription: The name of the object in the gateway's responses that carries an Assist model's session. Empty: no sessions, so every Assist request carries the conversation over in one message (slower, but it works).

solder.modelFilter.description: A regular expression: only models whose id matches it are offered (for example, only tool-calling ones).

solder.modelNames.markdownDescription: Short names for the model picker: `{ "<model id>": "<name>" }`.

solder.readOnly.markdownDescription: Read-only mode: Solder reads, searches and explains your code, but can't create, edit, move or delete files. Solder starts in it; turn it off with **Enable tools** at the top of Solder's panel, in the guided setup, or in Solder's Settings. Nothing turns it on again but you.

enumDescriptions: Much more thought: slower, and uses significantly more tokens.

solder.compactAtTokens.description: Summarise the older part of a chat once it passes this many tokens. Every step resends the whole chat, so lower costs less.

solder.maxRounds.description: The most replies with tool calls for one message.

solder.assistMaxRounds.description: The most replies with tool calls for one message when the chat's model is an Assist model. Higher than Max rounds by default: an Assist model's tokens aren't billed.

solder.assistCarryTokens.markdownDescription: How much of a conversation is carried over to an Assist model in one request, in tokens (at about four characters each): when a chat switches to one, when the gateway's session has ended, or on every request if the gateway keeps no session. Keep it well inside what your Assist models can hold.

solder.rules.description: Your rules for the model, a few plain lines, added to every chat.

solder.instructionFiles.description: Project instruction files the model follows, by file name only: the one at the workspace root, and the nearest one when it reads files in a subfolder.

solder.storageLimitGB.markdownDescription: The most disk space, in GB, that Undo's backups may use (the copies Solder keeps before each change). Past it, the oldest go first; there's no time limit. Deleting a chat removes its backups.

enumDescriptions: Words only: the index stays on this PC, and only the passages the model reads are sent.
Words and meaning: each passage of your docs is also sent once to the gateway's embeddings model, so a search finds passages that say the same thing in other words.
solder.docsSearch.markdownDescription: How docs search finds passages. **hybrid** needs **Embeddings model** and sends every passage of your docs folders to the gateway once (then only changed files), plus each search's words.

solder.embeddingModel.description: The gateway's embeddings model, for docs search by meaning (Docs search: hybrid).

solder.embedTokensPerMinute.markdownDescription: The most tokens docs search by meaning sends to the embeddings model in a minute. A gateway that allows only so many a minute refuses the rest, so a big folder is sent at this pace. `0`: no limit. A gateway on this PC isn't paced.

solder.meaningFloor.markdownDescription: How near in meaning a passage must be to a docs search to count, from just above 0 to 1. `0`: Solder's own floor, 0.58. Embeddings models score on their own scales, so tune it for yours by the log (Copy diagnostics), which shows each search's best similarity.

solder.embedDailyBudget.markdownDescription: The most tokens docs search by meaning may send to the embeddings model in a day (the gateway's day, from midnight UTC). Past it, embedding waits for the next day; keyword search goes on. `0`: no embedding. A gateway on this PC isn't counted.

solder.embeddingsCache.markdownDescription: A folder for sharing docs embeddings between PCs, a network share as a rule (`\\server\share\solder-embeddings`). What one PC has embedded for search by meaning, the others take from here: no tokens, nothing against the daily budget. It holds numbers only (no text, no file names), one small file per indexed file. Empty: every PC embeds for itself.

solder.skillsFolders.markdownDescription: Folders of your skills: instructions for particular kinds of task, one `.md` file each, named after the skill (`python_scripts.md`), starting with a line `When to use: …`. The model is told each skill's name and when to use it, and reads a skill whole before a task it covers. A new skill is saved in the first folder. Only files directly in a folder count; at most 50 skills are offered.

solder.skillsOff.markdownDescription: Skills you've switched off, by name: the model isn't told about them. Switch a skill on or off in **Settings → Skills**; a project's page has its own switches, for that project's chats alone.

about.description: A few words on what's in it, so the model knows when to look there.

solder.docsFolders.markdownDescription:
Folders of your own reference docs (APIs, schematics, specifications) that the model can search, in every workspace. Each is a path, or `{ "path": "…", "about": "…" }`. Indexed on this PC only; only the passages the model looks at are sent.

**What's searched:** any plain text (`.txt`, `.md`, `.rst`, `.html`, `.xml`, `.json`, `.yaml`, `.csv`, `.log`, code and headers such as `.c`, `.h`, `.py`, `.cs`, `.ps1`…, in UTF-8 or UTF-16) and Word, Excel and PowerPoint (`.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, and their macro versions).

**Not searched:** PDFs, images and scans, the old `.doc`, `.xls` and `.ppt` formats, and files over 5 MB (40 MB for Office files). Up to 20,000 files per folder; `.git` and `node_modules` are skipped.

Add one with **Use as Solder docs** on a folder in the Explorer.
